prior_text: PDK2 is detected in all four cell classes (neurons, astrocytes, oligodendrocyte-lineage, microglia) at the highest or near-highest level among the four kinases.
reading: PDK2 is detected in every class (lowest mean 0.33 FPKM, human myeloid) but is not near the top everywhere: mouse astrocytes Pdk4 63.70 against Pdk2 17.27 (3.7-fold); human astrocytes and oligodendrocytes PDK4-dominant in two datasets; human neuron clusters PDK3 3- to 5-fold above PDK2. It is top in mouse neurons and mouse oligodendrocyte lineage only.

prior_text: PDK3 is the lowest or absent in cortical cell classes.
reading: PDK3 is the highest kinase in human cortical neuron clusters (63.7-111.4 nCPM) and in the human macrophage cluster, and second in mouse newly formed and myelinating oligodendrocytes (20.88, 23.97 FPKM). It is lowest only in mouse astrocytes (4.61 FPKM).

prior_text: PDK4 is higher in astrocytes (or endothelium) than in neurons.
reading: RNA: mouse astrocytes 63.70 against neurons 2.17; human snRNA astrocytes 151.4 against neuron clusters 0.1-2.6; human immunopanned mature astrocytes 22.59 against 1 neuron sample 3.30; endothelium above neurons in both species. Protein by IHC does not separate them: PDK4 is High in cortical neuronal and glial compartments.

prior_text: PDK1 in cortical cells at physiological conditions is low relative to PDK2.
reading: Held in mouse neurons, astrocytes and oligodendrocyte lineage (PDK1 4.0-9.7 against PDK2 13.8-36.2 FPKM) and in human mature astrocytes (0.94 against 7.52). Fails in mouse microglia (9.87 against 7.19) and endothelium (9.12 against 6.04), in the human neuron sample (2.50 against 1.10, n=1) and in human neuron clusters (PDK1 20.7-27.0 against PDK2 15.1-26.2 nCPM, about equal), and in the macrophage cluster (54.0 against 8.2).

prior_text: Where RNA and protein are both available for the same cell class, the rank order of the four kinases is not identical.
reading: Human adult cortex neurons: RNA order PDK3 > PDK1 about PDK2 >> PDK4 (nCPM); IHC order PDK4 High above PDK1, PDK2, PDK3 Medium. Glia: RNA PDK4 > PDK3 > PDK2 > PDK1 in the astrocyte cluster; IHC PDK4 High, PDK1 Low, PDK2 and PDK3 Not detected. Caveats: IHC is ordinal, antibodies differ in reliability, compartments are not sorted cells; mouse protein was not reached, so the test is human only.
